what: GE Aerospace (the former General Electric) makes jet engines for commercial and military aircraft, mostly through CFM International with Safran, and earns most of its profit servicing them.
customers: Airlines, aircraft makers (Boeing, Airbus), lessors and the US military.
money: LEAP and GE9X engines, spare parts and long-term service
moat: A huge installed fleet of engines that generates decades of high-margin service revenue.
risks: Aircraft production delays at Boeing and Airbus
